subject: NovaClinic — VPC/on‑prem qualifying notes & next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novaclinic VPC Discovery — notes & asks

Thanks again for the time today, Samir — good conversation. Quick recap from our side and a short list of asks so your infra/security team can evaluate feasibility.

Pain points we heard (your priority ranking):
- Data residency & regulatory: PHI must remain in US regions and some facilities require an air‑gapped/isolated instance for research workloads.
- Network posture: corporate egress is heavily restricted; outbound IPs are NATed through a firewall proxy and only certain destination IP/ports are allowed.
- Integration: need to pull/send batched data to your EHR via SFTP and call out to an internal validation webhook in the VPC.
- Availability: pilot workload expects ~30rps during peak with 95th‑pct latency target ~150ms for prompt roundtrips.

Technical notes / constraints we discussed:
- Preferred deployment: Redwood Private (VPC peering or Private-Link) with optional on‑prem air‑gap for three research sites.
- Connectivity: customers typically choose either (A) site-to-site VPN + explicit firewall rules for Redwood egress IP ranges, or (B) a one‑way pull model (your side pulls) to satisfy outbound policy.
- Certificates: mutual TLS for internal webhooks is supported; we need cert CN and expiry policy.

Asks / next steps (we'll action on our side once we have these):
1) Please send a simple network diagram showing NAT/firewall boundaries and whether the sites can accept inbound connections or only allow outbound. (see attached novaclinic-network-sketch.pdf)
2) Confirm whether any sites are fully air‑gapped (no internet) and if physical media transfer for model weights is required.
3) Share a point of contact on procurement and estimated timeline for an initial pilot (Samir, looping procurement helps).
4) If helpful, we can share a short SOC2 excerpt (attached) and an example SOW/quote.

We'll hold a 60m technical deep‑dive with our Solutions Engineers the week of 3/20 — propose Wed 3/20 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 3/21 09:00–10:00 PT. Which works for you?

Attachments: novaclinic-network-sketch.pdf (diagram), SOC2-section3-excerpt.txt

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez

Sergio — thanks for the thorough notes. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 
- Confirmed: PHI must be stored and processed in US-only regions. Two of our research sites are likely to require an air‑gapped approach.
- Connectivity: production EHR systems do not accept inbound connections; everything must be pulled or brokered via a secured outbound path.

Could you also provide a ballpark monthly cost range for a pilot (expected ~30rps peak) and an example SOW length (6/12 week pilot)? Procurement is asking for a rough number before we schedule the security deep‑dive.

Also, Wed 3/20 10:00 PT should work for a technical call.

—Samir

- Option B: Private VPC + air‑gapped research instance (on‑prem data transfer for model weights; limited updates) — Pilot price range: $25k–$40k / month (adds ops runbook + 24/7 oncall during pilot). Pilot SOW: 12 weeks.
